row.title: SEED-DEPLOY-1: a fresh seed answers /health 503 until its first tick
row.body: A freshly deployed seed answers /health with 503 until its first cron tick completes, so a strict 200 probe read a running worker as dead. The seed deploy now starts the first tick through /pulse/watch and accepts a JSON answer naming the org; a failed probe records status and body in its ops/deploys.jsonl row. session_0156nqDth3dDYAsL8hsm79sa
